typography.description: Clear, legible, highly functional typography. Do not use Inter or Space Grotesk.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active elements, avoid large diffuse shadows. Flat UI preferred.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid completely rounded pill shapes.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Critical for structuring data tables, settings panels, and navigation separation.

components.buttons: Solid slate-900 for primary. Outline for secondary. Sharp or lightly rounded (rounded-md). Minimal hover (opacity or slight color shift).
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat design, visible borders between rows, clear column headers, p-4 padding. Left-align data.
components.cards: Cardless or minimal 1px bordered containers. Do not nest cards inside cards.
components.forms: Shadcn Form/Input. Stacked labels (label above input). Clear focus rings. Masked input for API Keys (RentCast / MapTiler).
components.navigation: Fixed left sidebar. High contrast active states (e.g., bg-slate-100 border-l-4 border-slate-900).
components.map: MapLibre GL implementation with explicit configuration for OpenStreetMap (default) and MapTiler (BYOK satellite).

layouts.general: High density grid for data, 1-column max-w-3xl for forms/settings. No complex workflow builders.
layouts.spacing: p-6 to p-8 for main content containers. gap-6 between major sections. K.I.S.S. principle.
layouts.sidebar: w-64 fixed on desktop. Mobile off-canvas (Shadcn Sheet).

motion.interactions: Fast and snappy. 150ms transitions for hover states. No complex entrance animations. Avoid layout shifts.
motion.page_transitions: None. Keep it feeling like a highly responsive local application.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. High contrast text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard', data-testid='save-settings').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2) on all interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Roofing residential house. Use as full-screen background for the login page with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/80) to ensure the login card stands out.

media.icons: lucide-react (default choice). Use clear, universally recognized icons.

3d_libraries: Not applicable for this context. Use 2D MapLibre GL for the map interface.
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow K.I.S.S. (Keep It Simple, Stupid). Design for a roofing salesperson or office manager who needs no training.
Do NOT create complex dashboard clutter or excessive cards. Prefer clear lists and simple detail screens.
For Settings (under Administration), implement Tabs: Integrations (RentCast API key, toggle, Test Connection), Map Configuration (OpenStreetMap vs MapTiler), Company Profile.
For API key inputs, use masked inputs (type='password') with a toggle visibility button.
Implement a clean left-sidebar App Shell with the exact navigation items: Dashboard, Leads, Map, Customers, Jobs, Inventory, Finance, Reports, Administration.
Make Phase 1 sections functional (Auth, Users, Roles, Audit Logs, Settings, Map). Other links can point to empty shell placeholders.
Use HTML/Tailwind for basic structural layout. Use Shadcn for interactive components (Forms, Tables, Dropdowns, Tabs, Modals).
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are present on every interactive and key element for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Ensure buttons are functional and clear, with hover animations limited to color shifts or slight shadow changes.
Avoid generic AI design slop. Create distinct layout hierarchy utilizing borders and padding.
All components must be accessible and responsive. NEVER use transparent backgrounds where content sits below.
Avoid using Shadcn Card component excessively for layout structuring: Go flat, rectangular, dense styles instead.
